evaluation_system_002.answer: California Standards for the Teaching Profession (CSTP) and District CSTP Continuum of Standards for the Teaching Profession
evaluation_system_002.evidence: The parties shall use the California Standards for the Teaching Profession (CSTP); and the jointly developed District Continuum of Standards for the Teaching Profession, which includes the CSTP Indicators (District CSTP Continuum)...

evaluation_observation_count_003.answer: At least one (1) observation prior to the end of each November; at least 4 formal observations prior to a 'Does Not Meet Standards' rating.
evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: 5.3 At least one (1) observation shall occur prior to the end of each November. 5.8 At least 4 formal observations shall take place prior to a "Does Not Meet Standards" rating

evaluation_observation_duration_004.answer: At least one full teacher lesson presentation
evaluation_observation_duration_004.evidence: 5.2 An observation shall include information from at least one full teacher lesson presentation

evaluation_ratings_005.answer: "demonstrates expertise," "meets standards," "growth expected," or "not meeting standards"
evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: Unit members shall receive an overall rating of "demonstrates expertise," "meets standards," "growth expected," or "not meeting standards" in each of the six standards of the CSTP.
